chunks.arabic_text: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ الصَّفَّارِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ فَضَّالٍ قَالَ

translations.en: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Walid narrated to us from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar from Isa ibn Ubayd from Ibn Faddal who said:
translations.tr: Muhammed b. el-Hasan b. el-Velid bize rivayet etti, Muhammed b. el-Hasan es-Saffar'dan, İsa b. Ubeyd'den, İbn Faddal'dan ki o dedi:

chunks.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ الرِّضَا ع يَقُولُ: مَنْ وَاصَلَ لَنَا قَاطِعاً أَوْ قَطَعَ لَنَا وَاصِلاً أَوْ مَدَحَ لَنَا عَائِباً أَوْ أَكْرَمَ لَنَا مُخَالِفاً فَلَيْسَ مِنَّا وَلَسْنَا مِنْهُ.

translations.en: I heard al-Rida (peace be upon him) say: Whoever maintains relations with one who severs them from us, or severs relations with one who maintains them for us, or praises one who reviles us, or honors one who dissents from us, is not from us and we are not from him.

en.summary: In *Sifat al-Shia*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this hadith from Imam al-Rida (as) to define the sociological boundaries of the true Shia through the concept of *al-wasl* (maintaining ties) and *al-qat'* (cutting ties) specifically directed toward the Ahl al-Bayt. This criterion emphasizes that loyalty is not merely internal belief but is demonstrated through external social alignment with the Imams' friends and enemies, serving as a practical test of *wilayah*. By linking these four specific behaviors to the declaration 'he is not from us,' the Imam establishes a clear marker of sectarian identity distinct from the general Muslim community.
en.seo_question: What are the four signs that a person is not from the Ahl al-Bayt according to Imam al-Rida?

key_terms.قَاطِعاً: one who severs or cuts off
key_terms.عَائِباً: one who reviles or finds fault
key_terms.فَلَيْسَ مِنَّا: he is not from us (not of our party)
key_terms.وَلَسْنَا مِنْهُ: and we are not from him
